In a recent development, the final whistle is blown at Old Trafford and Manchester United claim a 4-0 victory on their return to the Champions League. Goals from Cunha, Fernandes, Sesko and Martinez give Michael Carrick’s side three points in their opening game of the competition. Debutants Sabah return home with nothing and no goals, despite some decent chances to get a goal.

A number of empty seats at Old Trafford are becoming visible as some home fans have seen enough, knowing their side is going to win.

Industry observers note that sabah have had a few chances to come away from their Champions League debut with a goal but have wasted some great chances, including one just now. Mickels delivers a lovely cross from the left, which perfectly picks out Mbina, but his header goes just over the bar.

There will be three added minutes.

Mickels wasted a glorious chance in the first half and he comes close to goal a now but drags his shot just wide of the far post from the left side of the box.

Sources indicate that how on earth have the officials missed that one? Cunha catches Almeida on the leg and it should be at least a booking but the officials do not see it, despite the linesman being not far away. Cunha is very lucky as that was a nasty challenge.

Sabah would love to at the very least send their travelling fans back to Azerbaijan with a goal on their Champions League debut. You do wonder how different the game could have been had Mickels not missed a sitter that would have seen Sabah make it 1-1.

Michael Carrick is going to make his final two changes of the night as youngsters Lacey and Amass come on.

A bit of a soft goal for Sabah to concede. Fernandes clips in a free-kick into the Sabah box which picks out the run of Zirkzee. The Dutchman’s backheel is blocked and Sabah should then deal with the danger. However, Sabah make an absolute mess of things and their keeper Pokatilov has no idea where the ball is, allowing Martinez to nick in and smash the ball into the net.

Lisandro Martínez pounces on a defensive mistake from Sabah to make it four 🫣📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/eTAYgMmV9Q.

Lepinjica is the first Sabah player into the book tonight for a cynical trip on Mount.

Zirkzee, only just on the pitch, shoots from range but it is straight down the throat of Pokatilov.

Puchacz takes the free-kick from just over 25 yards out and strikes it well but the effort is just off target.

In a recent development, perhaps with the Manchester derby on Sunday in mind, Michael Carrick is going to make a double change. Zirkzee and Santos replace Sesko and Mainoo.

It has been revealed that dorgu is the first player into the book tonight. Lepinjica spots the run of Parris into the right channel and plays a clever pas forward. Dorgu cynically brings Parris down and is rightly booked.

The visitors are making a change as Parris is replaced by Isaev.

Manchester United come close to a fourth and Cunha his second. The home side work it well near the Sabah penalty area with a couple of clever flicks and passes before Cunha has an effort saved by Pokatilov to his left.

According to recent reports, mazraoui receives it out in space on the right and cuts inside onto his left. He comes across the face of the penalty area before getting his shot away but his effort is off target.

Sabah are enjoying a decent spell of possession but have not yet threatened Lammens’ goal in this second half.

According to recent reports, is Yoro lucky? Mickels appeared to turn him not far outside the Manchester United penalty area but Yoro is not penalised. It did on first viewing look like a foul and would have been at least a yellow card.

We are back under way at Old Trafford. How promptly might Michael Carrick make changes with Sunday’s Manchester derby in mind? Well, he has made one change at the break as Mount replaces Tielemans. It is Mount’s first appearance of the season. Sabah have brought on Mbina at the break.

The first half is brought to an end and Manchester United are cruising towards victory on their return to the Champions League. It has all gone wrong for Sabah.

That is game, set and match before half-time at Old Trafford as the dam has burst for Sabah. Sesko is played in behind by Mbeumo and is one-on-one with Pokatilov. Sesko takes it around Pokatilov before putting it into the empty net.

Benjamin Šeško rounds the goalkeeper to make it three for Manchester United 🔄📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/tnslugsmZM.

Michael Carrick’s side have their second of the night not long before half-time and it is a well-taken goal. Cunha, from the left side of the box, plays it inside to Tielemans. The Belgian takes one touch before, on the turn, playing it back into the path of Fernandes, who finds the net with a first-time finish.

Bruno Fernandes and Youri Tielemans combine to double Manchester United's lead ✌️📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/nZnkwLWJ00.

Fernandes has an effort from the edge of the Sabah box but blazes his effort high over the bar.

That’s a warning there for United. Fernandes gives the ball away in the middle with a heavy touch and Sabah break through the tall, languid figure of Lepinjica. Parris’ cross loops the far post where Mickels should have done better than steer an inviting header into the side netting. Bit of a let off for Carrick’s side.

Sabah should be level as they miss a sitter. Parris, from the right side of the box, clips a cross to the back post that picks out Mickels. He should score but puts his header into the side netting. That should have been the equaliser for Sabah.

Dorgu clips in a cross from the left side of the box and picks out Sesko, whose hooked first-time effort goes just wide.

Half an hour in and United have been in command. It’s not scintillating but they warrant their lead and punished a misplaced pass by Parris brutally. Mainoo is orchestrating the game in the middle of the pitch. Best player on the park so far.

Parris’ shot from the edge of the box takes a deflection and goes behind for a corner. It is wasted though by Sabah as the inswinger is easily caught by Lammens.

Tielemans steps in with a crucial interception inside his own box to deny Mickels the chance of a shot on goal.

Sources indicate that the Brazilian has his first Champions League goal but it is gifted by Sabah. The visitors are threatening a counter-attack but Parris inexplicably gives the ball away on halfway with a dreadful pass across the pitch. The ball is then moved out to the left, where Dorgu crosses. He picks out Cunha, whose first-time effort with his side foot hits the Sabah keeper Pokatilov and goes into the net. A sense of frustration had been growing inside Old Trafford but Sabah have rather gifted Manchester United the opener there.

Matheus Cunha opens the scoring for Manchester United with his first ever Champions League goal 🏄📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/ZDQBbEfizq.

Industry observers note that sabah give it away inside their own half and Manchester United flood forward towards the Sabah penalty area. Mbuemo drives forward and cuts inside onto his preferred left foot before getting his shot away from the edge of the box but it is straight at Pokatilov.

It has been revealed that that is outstanding defensive work from Dasdamirov. Mainoo plays a quite sensational first-time ball in behind into the right channel to pick out the run of Fernandez. The Manchester United captain has Sesko waiting in the middle for the cross but Dasdamirov steps in with an absolutely essential interception or else Sesko would have had a tap-in.

Sabah need to be careful as now a few times they have been caught in possession deep in their own territory.

Cunha sends in a corner from the left that threatens to go in at the far corner but Sabah keeper Pokatilov catches it near his own line.

Sabah are making their Champions League debut and so too tonight are Cesc Fabregas’ Como, who have just taken the lead at home against RB Leipzig. Manchester United will travel to Como in late October on matchday three. Manchester United play RB Leipzig at home on matchday six.

Sabah have to negotiate a couple of Manchester United corners in quick succession and they do so. The visitors’ starting XI tonight has a very international feel to it:.

Mazraoui plays a pass forward into Cunha on the right side of the box and the Brazilian tries to beat Pokatilov at the near post but the Sabah keeper makes the save and pushes it around the post for a corner.

Sabah are able to clear their lines from Mbeumo’s delivery.

Sabah seem content to take risks on the ball deep inside their own half and play out from the back. Will that be a masterstroke or is it asking for trouble?

Sabah make their first foray into the Manchester United penalty area and there are appeals for handball. It did hit Dorgu’s hand but it was right down by his side and that is not a deliberate handball. Sabah do win a corner, which Dorgu heads away.

In a recent development, sesko, fresh off what he thought was going to be the winner at Everton on Sunday, has been given the nod to start up top for the home side tonight. He is very close to closing the Sabah goalkeeper Pokatilov down inside his own six-yard box and that was nearly a horrific moment for the Champions League debutants a matter of minutes into their debut in this competition.

Sabah started their journey through the qualifying rounds of this comeptition back in the early parts of July so they have already played quite a number of games so far this season, in comparison to Manchester United’s three competitive fixtures coming into tonight.

As has been the case at every Champions League game this week, there is a moment silence to remember the victims of the recent deadly floods in Nepal.

We are under way at Old Trafford. Manchester United, three-time winners of this trophy, return to the Champions League whilst Sabah make their debut in the competition.

Sources indicate that it’s 1,003 days since the Champions League anthem has been heard at Old Trafford and, to be honest, it feels longer. There are about 500 Sabah fans here tonight.

Michael Carrick has made four changes for Sabah to the team that drew 2-2 against Everton. Benjamin Sesko is given his first start of the season with Marcus Rashford dropping to the bench. Luke Shaw was given an additional rest day on Wednesday and is left out of the squad. It makes sense with Sunday’s derby against Manchester City to come but it’s an early glimpse of the delicate balance Carrick will have to strike with his only recognised senior left back this season. Shaw can’t be expected to play every few days given his history of injury problems.

Recent findings suggest that it looks like Patrick Dorgu will be operating at left back against Sabah. This is United’s 300th fixture in the European Cup, including qualifiers. On the subject of qualifiers, Sabah became only the sixth side to navigate four qualifying rounds to reach the European Cup proper, with their campaign starting back on July 7. That was the same day Argentina beat Egypt in the last 16 of the World Cup. The Azerbaijan club were only formed nine years ago so have had quite the ascent since.

At 8pm on Thursday night, Manchester United will kick a ball in the Champions League for the first time in three seasons.

In a recent development, it must mark the start of a permanent return to Europe’s premier club competition. If United are serious about once again challenging for the Premier League title and building a £2bn stadium, that must be the way forward.

This is only the seventh time in 13 campaigns that United have been in the Champions League and the implications have been significant.

Presenting your Champions League Reds 📋❤️‍🔥.

Manchester United make their return to the Champions League as they host tournament debutants Sabah of Azerbaijan on matchday one at Old Trafford. It will be the first time that Manchester United have faced an Azerbaijani side in European competition.

In a recent development, manchester United have one win, one loss and one draw to their name in their opening three Premier League games. They were seconds away from winning their second game of the season on Sunday but conceded a late equaliser at Everton. They last featured in the Champions League during the 2023/24 season, when they were eliminated in the group stage, and have won just one of their last nine games in the competition.

“It means an awful lot [to be back in the Champions League],” Manchester United boss Michael Carrick said. “Challenging yourself against the elite, the very best. This football club has been used to being the best. It is not something you can take for granted. We missed out on it for a number of years and now we are back. It is where we expect to be without getting ahead of ourselves. We have made huge steps to make it in, now it is about pushing into the next chapter and evolution if the squad and this is certainly where we want to be.

“I do not think it is a case of if we get to a certain stage it is a success and if we do not it is not. We have to embrace the newly introduced challenge that we are facing as a group and push to what we can push to. If we get further down the line in this competition then who knows? I am not writing anything off. But we are taking it step by step and we certainly are not getting ahead of ourselves. We have got a squad that is strong enough to compete.”.

Sabah make their Champions League debut having been founded just eight years ago in September 2017. Back in April, they secured the Azerbaijan top-flight title for the first time in their history and also won the Azerbaijan Cup in May. They earned a spot in the Champions League group stages after beating Hapoel Be’er Sheva 6-4 on aggregate. In the previous three seasons, they have tried to reach the group stages of the Europa and Conference Leagues but failed to do so. They have won all three leagues thus far, including a 5-0 home win over Zira last Saturday.

Industry observers note that nel pre-partita di Milan-Frosinone, gara che si disputerà a San Siro domenica alle ore 18 valida per la dodicesima giornata del campionato di Serie A, Fondazione Milan sarà protagonista con il racconto delle storie più significative di alcuni dei suoi beneficiari (LEGGI QUI IL COMUNICATO). Scenderanno al fianco della Fondazione Milan alcuni ex campioni come Massimo Ambrosini e Daniele Massaro oltre che Matteo Gabbia, indisponibile per la gara perchè infortunato e sempre molto vicino alle attività dell'ente benefico. Nel corso del pre-gara ci sarà anche un momento dedicato al Capitano Franco Baresi che aveva una relazione profonda e fattiva con la Fondazione Milan.

Sources indicate that "Saranno loro i protagonisti del prepartita, tra momenti a bordocampo e la foto ufficiale con la squadra che scenderà in campo dal primo minuto. Al loro fianco Massimo Ambrosini, Legend rossonera e Ambassador della serata, oltre a Daniele Massaro, Brand Ambassador di AC Milan, e Matteo Gabbia, che nei giorni scorsi hanno visitato il progetto Calcio Seduto.

Un momento speciale sarà dedicato a Franco Baresi, per ricordarne il legame con Fondazione Milan e l'impegno con cui, anche come membro del suo Consiglio di Amministrazione, ne ha sostenuto i progetti. Il tributo coinvolgerà i dipendenti del Club e Daniele Massaro, suo storico compagno e amico".

Recent findings suggest that fin qui, Petar Sucic ha mostrato sprazzi di grande qualità, che hanno fatto strabuzzare gli occhi ai tifosi dell'Inter. Oltre al fatto che, con la sua duttilità, il giovane centrocampista croato si è rivelato un elemento molto utile per Chivu. Ora, però, serve la giusta continuità per diventare davvero un elemento imprescindibile dei nerazzurri. Così il Corriere dello Sport:.

"Quando l’Inter si è fiondata su Petar Sucic, addirittura bloccandolo quando ancora era infortunato, era convinta che potesse allungare la tradizione favorevole dei croati in maglia nerazzurra. E le aspettative nei confronti dell’ex Dinamo Zagabria non si sono di certo abbassate col tempo. In viale della Liberazione sono tuttora convinti di aver fiutato l’ennesimo affare. Per quanto visto, i margini di crescita esistono e sono anche abbondanti. Affinché il binomio con la Croazia si riveli ancora prezioso come fu all’epoca per Brozovic, Kovacic e Perisic, tocca ora a Chivu trovare la chiave giusta per aiutarlo esprimersi con una continuità finora mai raggiunta".

Recent findings suggest that "La sua duttilità è tornata utile in nerazzurro, perché ha permesso al rumeno di impiegarlo sia da interno di centrocampo che da play in base alle esigenze, ma di fatto mai dove viene impiegato dal suo ct. Con la maglia della Croazia è abitudine ormai vedere Sucic svariare sulla trequarti avversaria, più libero dal faldone dei compiti in fase di non possesso che in nerazzurro non può in alcun modo lasciare sulla scrivania dei compagni di centrocampo. Proprio nell’atteggiamento mostrato alcune volte inseguendo gli avversari o nelle letture sbagliate il numero 8 dell’Inter deve dare risposte importanti a Chivu.

According to recent reports, il tema era emerso lo scorso anno e ora, con un bagaglio d’esperienza sicuramente più pieno, i presupposti per alzare le pretese nei suoi confronti ci sono tutti. Da qui a Natale serviranno anche le sue qualità per continuare nel percorso fatto finora in Serie A e Champions, così come per avanzare in Coppa Italia e provare a mettere il primo punto esclamativo stagionale in Supercoppa. Le chance non mancheranno: alzando il livello di cattiveria potrà confermarsi erede legittimo dei croati passati in questi anni nella Milano nerazzurra".

In a recent development, marco Pasotto, giornalista, si è così espresso su La Gazzetta dello Sport sull'idea Gabriele Calvani per la difesa del Milan: "Calvani è sbocciato quest'anno nello stuzzicante Frosinone di Alvini, che fa volare i suoi ragazzi, organizza benissimo impianto tattico e flusso di gioco, e agevola quindi la crescita di tutti i giocatori. È alla seconda stagione in prestito a Frosinone, il cartellino appartiene al Genoa ed è indicativo che il Grifone lo abbia concesso ai giallazzurri soltanto in prestito secco in entrambe le annate: significa che il talento è evidente e il club rossoblù conta di ricavarne un buon affare in caso di cessione a una big. Calvani ha svoltato con Alvini, che nel suo 4-2-3-1 lo impiega sul centrodestra. Sempre titolare fino a questo momento, a parte la sfida col Sassuolo. Domenica prossima tra l'altro c'è Milan-Frosinone, anche se al momento è presto per capire se i rossoneri potranno osservarlo dal vivo al Meazza: il difensore ha avuto un problema al flessore in Nazionale U21 ed è tornato anzitempo a Frosinone".

Pasotto ha parlato dei margini della trattativa: "Di certo, pur trattandosi di un palcoscenico nobile, non sarebbe comunque questa l'occasione per presentarsi al Diavolo: il Milan lo stava già seguendo e messo in lista. Il canale col Genoa tra l'altro è caldo perché i due club dovrebbero incontrarsi per definire il prestito in rossoblù di Comotto. Calvani piace al Milan per anagrafe e motivi pratici. E' bravo nelle marcature alte, e sappiamo come il progetto di Amorim sia quello di alzare progressivamente il baricentro di squadra. È valido sui palloni alti, ha personalità (si ispira a Rudiger, il che racconta molto), ha una buona tecnica di base e non disdegna le uscite palle al piede. È migliorato molto in sicurezza, soprattutto considerando che è alla sua prima esperienza in A. La sua crescita di quest’anno ha colpito parecchio, nell'ambito di un contesto collettivo ideale".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

L’ex giocatore ricorda i rimproveri nello spogliatoio del Milan e gli scherzi organizzati con Pirlo.

Massimo Oddo indica in Gennaro Gattuso il principale artefice del primato della Lazio in Serie A. L’ex giocatore biancoceleste e del Milan ha parlato del rapporto con l’amico ed ex compagno di squadra in un’intervista a Repubblica. Oltre al giudizio sull’attuale allenatore della Lazio, ha ricordato il ruolo che aveva nello spogliatoio rossonero e alcuni episodi vissuti insieme.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Recent findings suggest that secondo Oddo, l’esperienza da commissario tecnico della Nazionale, conclusa senza la qualificazione ai Mondiali, ha inciso sulla consapevolezza di Gattuso. Non ne avrebbe però cambiato il modo di essere: «Gattuso non cambia, migliora. Da ct, mancando la qualificazione ai Mondiali, ha subito una delle lezioni sportive più grandi della sua carriera, non solo per il risultato. Adesso ha preso ancora più consapevolezza di prima».

Oddo riconosce nell’allenatore della Lazio un ruolo che aveva già ai tempi del Milan: «ma è sempre stato un “braccio armato” pronto a intervenire e risolvere i momenti di crisi. Già ai tempi del Milan. Rino rieducava senza mai punire». Il richiamo arrivava anche per piccoli ritardi e, nel suo racconto, non richiedeva l’intervento del club.

In a recent development, L’ex compagno precisa: «bastavano due minuti di ritardo – capitava soprattutto ai brasiliani, esclusi Dida e Kakà – e scattava il rimprovero. Non serviva l’intervento della società».

#15365. Tech Report: Xabi Alonso hits out at ‘soft’ Chelsea players

Tech Report: Xabi Alonso hits out at ‘soft’ Chelsea players

📅 12 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 23 min read (4651 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~23 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Xabi Alonso accused his Chelsea players of being “soft” after they failed to keep a clean sheet for the 20th successive Premier League game.
  • Chelsea threw away an early lead to draw 2-2 with Hull City and have conceded two or more goals in each of their four Premier League games.
  • Alonso has tried different systems and different players in those games, but suggested Chelsea’s biggest problem is mental.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Xabi Alonso accused his Chelsea players of being “soft” after they failed to keep a clean sheet for the 20th successive Premier League game.

Chelsea threw away an early lead to draw 2-2 with Hull City and have conceded two or more goals in each of their four Premier League games.

Alonso has tried different systems and different players in those games, but suggested Chelsea’s biggest problem is mental.

The club’s dreadful clean-sheet record pre-dates him and is the first time in 65 years Chelsea have gone 20 league games without keeping the opposition out.

In a recent development, hull’s first goal from Mohamed Belloumi came after the ball had bounced over Jorrel Hato and Alonso noted: “We need to be aware that from any situation, any team in the Premier League can hurt you. Today it was from a long ball, two bounces, the way it happened. You need to be very aware, very ready that the danger can come from any situation. If you are soft or if you are not prepared, you will get punished and we have been punished that way.”.

Chelsea have shared 30 goals with their opponents in the club’s six games in all competitions so far this season.

“Yeah, it’s all maybe entertaining, but I hope that one day you say it was a boring game and we win and we don’t give these entertaining moments,” he remarked.

According to recent reports, “But, for sure, it kind of repeats some patterns that we are making. It will take time to... or it will take moments to fix them when we get the lead and you still need to be competing and not give the chance so easily for them to come back, especially in the first goal, we can do much better.

It has been revealed that “It was too soft to give them this hope because until then we were controlling, we were creating chances. But that momentum that we had changed the mood and the score of the game, and it’s something that we need to be talking [about], we address and we will get better. But it’s having an impact on our performances at the moment.”.

Asked if his players have a real desire to defend and keep clean sheets, Alonso remarked: “We can do better, we can do better for sure. We need to know that even when we have the lead, a very important part of the game is to hold together, to keep the distance, to go intense in the situations to defend. I’m sure that we can do better.

Industry observers note that “Overall, I think that we are attacking better than defending in every part. We know that it’s a major topic and a big theme for us. For sure, it’s just four games. But the dynamic in terms of conceding, I don’t like it and we need to do much better. Open play, set-pieces, long balls, this toughness, this competitive sense, we can do better.”.

Needing three goals or more to win games is not sustainable, as Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso is finding out.

In a recent development, this is not a problem of Alonso’s making, given Chelsea have now gone 20 Premier League games without a clean sheet. But he is certainly not improving the matter yet.

Chelsea beat Fulham with three goals and Brighton with four but left themselves far too much to do against Arsenal and were taken advantage of by Hull City, who will be slightly disappointed they did not leave Stamford Bridge with all three points.

Goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez has now conceded seven goals in three games since joining from Aston Villa, while central defender Maxence Lacroix, who joined for £52m from Crystal Palace in the summer, was relegated to the substitutes’ bench.

Martínez was at fault for Mohamed Belloumi’s second goal, but the Argentine did make a crucial save at his back post to stop substitute Mohamed-Ali Cho grabbing a winner that Chelsea could have had no complaints about.

Hull finished the game with more shots on goal than their hosts and a higher expected-goals rate. Chelsea are far too open and in some ways far too entertaining.

It has been revealed that defensive midfielder Moisés Caicedo cannot return from injury quickly enough, but this does not feel like a problem that will be solved by one man. Alonso needs to find a balance and instil a real desire in his team to defend.

Caicedo has that desire, but there are no defenders at the club who have shown that absolute desperation to keep the ball out of the net that Chelsea fans became so used to in the days of John Terry, Gary Cahill and César Azpilicueta.

None of this should diminish Hull’s performance. They were not only spirited and full of character but also highlighted quality and a threat. The joke is right now on those who laughed at their hopes of survival before a ball had been kicked.

Recent findings suggest that it is now two wins and two draws for Sergej Jakirovic’s team and they are already a fifth of the way to 40 points. Jakirovic had promised his staff a week off in the international break if they reached eight points after five games. With that target already met, there may be a upcoming reward if Hull can make it 11 points against Newcastle United next weekend.

In a recent development, “Before the season, I said to my staff that we will take seven, eight points in these first five and then I will give them seven days off,” Jakirovic said. “That was our target and now we are in a very good position, eight points.

“Especially today, it’s very, very difficult to play here, and now we will try to get even more. Of course, I’m a little bit worried about the international break because we have 13 national team players. But we will see who will come back and in what condition. So this is my concern right now.” Asked if his staff’s seven-day break will be extended if Hull can beat Newcastle, Jakirovic added: “I will tell them. But I know already.”.

While his five-game target may need modifying, Jakirovic is not deviating from his goal for the season for Hull. “Our target is always to stay in the league and collect as many points as possible,” he mentioned. “Forty points, 38 to 41, this is the average we need. Then it’s easier to play. You can play more relaxed, with more joy and happiness. So [get to] this as soon as possible, so that we are safe.”.

Industry observers note that hull had not conceded a league goal before this and there had been predictions they might crumble when they finally let the ball into their net. They did so after just seven minutes but they kept their heads and came back stronger.

It was far too easy for Morgan Rogers to make a yard of space for himself to shoot after collecting the ball from João Pedro, and Hull goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis may not have been happy to have been beaten at his near post.

Chelsea have now scored inside the first 10 minutes in all of their four league games, but Hull were in no mood to crumble and hit back with two goals in six minutes from Belloumi to take a half-time lead. Both Hull goals were shockers from Chelsea’s perspective. The first, in the 28th minute, came as a result of Jorrel Hato letting the ball bounce over him from a Ryan Giles cross and Belloumi finished brilliantly.

Belloumi’s second came after Martínez had flapped at a corner and Semi Ajayi had hit the bar with a header. The ball fell to Belloumi again and his shot was deflected into the net.

It has been revealed that it was no surprise that Hato did not reappear for the second half, as he was replaced by Pep Chavarría at left-back. But Chelsea remained vulnerable and Martínez had to recover from spilling a Regan Slater shot to prevent Ollie McBurnie extending Hull’s advantage.

When Palmer and Pedro combined for Pedro to sweep the ball into the net and equalise with 24 minutes remaining, it seemed like it would be Chelsea who would provide the grandstand finish.

But it was Hull who got a second wind and Chelsea were indebted to Martínez for making a save to stop Cho securing all three points and sending the visiting fans home even happier.

Industry observers note that I feel good. We have to be happy. It’s a huge result for us.

According to recent reports, we had 2-1 at half-time and we had a 100 per cent chance with McBurnie but Martinez’s save was excellent. We have to control play better in the box because we can stop this [Chelsea goal]. We had an excellent chance for Cho – Martinez saved again. Player of the match.

We can be very happy. We took a point in a very demanding match.

Recent findings suggest that eight points against very difficult opponents. We have to continue like this.

There have been 12 Premier League games at Anfield in 2026, Liverpool have only won 4 of them to date. This was seventh draw and Fulham deserves their share of the spoils. This was very much a learning experience for Andoni Iraola.

Not a single home win in the Premier League, today.

Aston Villa 1 Nottingham Forest 2Bournemouth 2 Brentford 2Chelsea 2 Hull City 2Crystal Palace 2 Ipswich Town 3Liverpool 0 Fulham 0.

What a result for Hull, who remain unbeaten and they have taken five points from fixtures against United, Villa and Chelsea.

That is the first really poor result of the Alonso era, points dropped.

What a thriller in SE25, both teams have been going for it in the closing stages, but Ipswich have surely score the winner through Zian Flemming.

Fulham were pointless before this game, but they have kept a clean sheet at Anfield with a disciplined display and they could well have score one or two. Underwhelming for Liverpool, who have not won just one of their first four games and their fixtures have not been the most taxing.

Recent findings suggest that and as we predicted at the beginning of the game... Liverpool 0 Fulham 0. If this reporter ever gives you advice on a horse to back or a team to follow, make sure you take the opposite stance. Fulham deserve their reward and their fans are singing “We got a point!”.

Villa are finishing the game with 10 men because Ian Maatsen pulled up after Emery had made his five substitutions, and Forest have punished them through Igor Jesus with just a few minutes of normal time to play.

Alexander Isak heads over the bar when he perhaps should have hit the target. Has time run out for Liverpool?

Industry observers note that you might imagine Chelsea are battering down the door, but Mohamed-Ali Cho has just forced Emi Martinez into a save at the other end. Hull will remain unbeaten if they can hold out.

Strand Larsen has had his critics, but he has scored his first goal of the season to set up a grandstand finish with 15 minutes plus stoppage time to play at Selhurst Park.

Short corner, McGinn whipped in an inswinging cross that is glanced into the bottom corner by Alysson.

It has been revealed that liverpool continue to toil at Anfield, but no opening goal. Iraola has thrown on Frimpong, Mac Allister, Ngumoha and Gakpo in the second half. Fulham have had the chances to score at least one, and Josh King has just brought a save out of Alisson.

Recent findings suggest that hull are a little lucky they still have 11 men on the pitch. Already on a booking, my man Crooks bundled down Rogers. It could easily have been another yellow car but the referee let him off and now he’s been replaced by Iroegbunam.

Joao Pedro finds the smallest of gaps to be the goalkeeper and find the roof of the net with a brilliant, instinctive finish.

According to recent reports, that had not really been coming for Chelsea. It all felt a bit easy for Palmer to get his low cross into the box and Pedro to sweep the ball in. The home fans have woken up again.

According to recent reports, martinez was lucky to get away with another slip up, there. He spilt Slater’s shot but reacted before McBurnie to stop the Hull striker scoring the rebound. Just a day after his nasty looking crash, Sorba Thomas is on for Hull.

It has been revealed that this game is absolutely here for Fulham to win. Quietness has descended around Anfield, the hosts have no fluency in their play and Fulham are growing in confidence. Why wouldn’t they after getting to 65 minutes with a clean sheet?

Just like in the first half, four minutes after one of these teams taking the lead there has been an equaliser. Kevin Scahde is in a rich vein of form.

In a recent development, bournemouth have have never beaten Brentford in the Premier League, but they might well be on their way to changing that record having trailed earlier in the game. Marcus Tavernier has just scored their second goal.

Matt Davidson Rider Crooks has just been booked for a very cynical foul on Rogers. It gave Chelsea a free-kick in a dangerous position Reece James had an effort tipped away. Chelsea have started the second half well.

In a recent development, within a minute of the restart, Villa lose the ball in midfield and Delap punishes them to the maximum. Cracking finish from just outside the box, and a much-needed goal by Delap. The Glasner curse striking for Emery again?

Liam Delap has just started paying back that £50m transfer fee with a fine goal.

Delap picked the ball up on the left and set himself up on the edge of the box before crashing a 25-yard shot past Zion Suzuki.

Unai Emery has made a couple of changes at half-time, taking off Nicolas Jackson who picked up a silly booking just before half-time.

In a recent development, tammy Abraham is on in his place. George Hemmings is also off and replaced by Alysson.

It has been revealed that pep Chavarria on for Chelsea at half-time. He’s replaced Jorrel Hato, who had a bit of a stinker in the first half.

In a recent development, andoni Iraola hasn’t hung about here. Milos Kerkez has come on immediately after half-time for Kostas Tsimikas and you can say with certainty that Liverpool will be shopping for a newly introduced left-back in due course.

Recent findings suggest that so at half-time, Hull City are top of the Premier League and don’t their supporters know it? They were singing “we are top of the League” for the full two minutes of time added on for stoppages at the end of the first period. Alonso has some work to do at the break.

Forest did need a brilliant double save from Matz Sels to deny Victor Lindelof and have recovered to slow the match down.

Neco Williams wasted a decent chance for Forest from outside the penalty area shortly before the break.

Referee Andrew Madley has irritated both teams with a number of weird decisions - but that’s sadly par for the course with officials nowadays.

Things got worse for Palace just before half-time, with Leif Davis heading home at the back post to give Ipswich the league.

Apologies for the lack of updates, some technical gremlins at Telegraph Towers. A nip and tuck game as expected at at the Vitality: Kevin Schade gave Brentford the lead before Justin Kluivert equalised four minutes later.

Industry observers note that one way to put it is that Kostas Tsimikas isn’t playing well. Another way to say it would be that his efforts are making Milos Kerkez look like Roberto Carlos. We suggested there was no chance of this game finishing goalless, and it’s anomalous that we have reached 40 minutes without score. Fulham, certainly, have a sense of adventure and have been into Liverpool’s 18-yard box plenty of times. Let’s see if the picture changes before the interval.

That’s now seven goals Emi Martinez has conceded in three games since joining from Villa to supposedly solve Chelsea’s goalkeeping crisis. Martinez won’t be pleased with Hull’s second goal, here. He was beaten to a corner by Ajayi. His header hit the bar and Belloumi’s shot was deflected past him. The Hull fans are in dreamland.

Sources indicate that this is a turn up for the books. Chelsea undone by a long ball forward, and Hato lets the ball bounce over his head, and Belloumi finishes with aplomb.

That’s now 20 Premier League games Chelsea have gone without keeping a clean sheet. What an earth was Jorrel Hato doing, letting the ball bounce over him for Belloumi? Amateur stuff at the back from the home side. It was Hull’s first meaningful attack.

Emersonn has struggled in some games so far this season, but he has just planted a header into the corner from a Davis cross.

There is a VAR check for offside... but the goal stands.

In a recent development, 5 - Morgan Rogers is the fifth different player to score or assist in each of Chelsea's first four games of a Premier League season, after Didier Drogba (2010-11), Cesc Fàbregas (2014-15), Diego Costa (2014-15 & 2016-17), and Eden Hazard (2018-19).Famous. pic.twitter.com/0cuThzH472.

A sweet strike from one of Palace’s summer signings, recruited from Union Saint Gilloise, and that is his first Palace goal. The 22-year-old Israeli came through at Maccabi Haifa. Uphill task for Gary O’Neill and Ipswich.

It has been revealed that austin MacPhee, Chelsea’s flamboyant set-piece coach, just motioned for Xabi Alonso to sit down when the Blues manager momentarily got up from his seat when the home side were preparing to take a corner. It seems MacPhee wears the (correct length) trousers when it comes to set pieces.

An almighty let off for Alisson and Liverpool after pass from the goalkeeper played Gravenberch into trouble, but Jacquet cleared off the line to keep the game goalless. That was Fulham’s first foray forward.

A bright start in this game and there is no chance it will end goalless (famous last words). Andoni Iraola has made three changes from the team that beat Atletico Madrid on Wednesday and it’s a pattern of his early management that he is making the kind of decisions that supporters are nodding along in approval with. Liverpool should already be one up but Alexander Isak’s shot has just drifted across the face of goal but the signs are encouraging. It could be a long afternoon for Alvaro Arbeloa.

Industry observers note that wow. Unbelievable double save from Forest’s Matz Sels there to keep out Victor Lindelof.

The first was the most impressive, a reflex stop after a deflection.

According to recent reports, morgan Rogers is the first player to score against Hull City this season. Emi Martinez rolled out the ball forward after claiming a corner, and Rogers’ shot from the edge of the area crept under the goalkeeper Tzolakis. He will not want to watch that one again.

According to recent reports, we’re past five minutes and it’s the longest Chelsea have gone without scoring in the league this season. Back on Matt Crooks – one of his middle names is Rider.

Although Rogers scored in the seventh minute...so the early goals continue for Chelsea. It will be difficult for Hull now.

Twelve seconds in and the chant “where were you in Istanbul” gets a very early airing from Villa’s home fans.

That is of course a reference to Villa’s 4-0 win over Forest in the Europa League semi-final second leg last season.

The early indications are that Reece James is playing in midfield with Malo Gusto at right-back in a conventional back four.

Xabi Alonso has made an encouraging start to life as Chelsea manager. But his trousers upset me. They are three inches too short and a bit baggy above the ankle.

Recent findings suggest that we are under way in the five Premier League 3pm kick-offs. Goals and further updates from around the grounds as they happen.

Some early #analysis from Matt at the Bridge, about one of Hull’s midfielders.

Matt Crooks is absolutely massive.

One player who has really shone for Villa so far this season is teenage midfielder George Hemmings.

Unai Emery has been very impressed with the academy graduate, who made his Champions League debut on Tuesday night.

There is also a big buzz around £51m signing Johan Manzambi, who is on the bench today after recovering from a knee injury.

It has been revealed that will we get another fast start from Chelsea today? They have scored inside the first five minutes in all three of their League games this season. Hull are yet to concede.

Recent findings suggest that dominic King writes that there were signs of promise in the relationship between Barcola, Wirtz and Isak in Liverpool’s win over Atletico Madrid, and all three forwards start against Fulham. Timothy Castagne, Fulham’s right-back will need to have his sprinting boots on against Barcola, who is grease lightning.

Cole Palmer has 15 goal involvements in his 15 Premier League games for Chelsea against newly promoted sides.9 goals ⚽6 assists 🅰️ pic.twitter.com/PJIU0YxIhQ.

I’m having real fun. I’ve got a smile on face and I’m enjoying my football. Playing with players like [Palmer and Joao Pedro] inspire you to be better and make you do better and do well for the team. We are in a good moment and we want to keep it going.

It has been revealed that hull are really tough to beat. They have played against some good opponents and they’ve kept them out - they haven’t conceded yet. It is going to be difficult because they are really organised but we are at home and it is on us to make the game about us.

Industry observers note that we know it is always tough against Brentford. We can expect a tight game today, definitely. We both want to win so it’ll be a nice game.

We are very excited about our first European game coming up but we haven’t really spoken about it lately because we have just spoken about this game. This is a major game and we are looking for our first three points of the season. We have been close in every game so we hope to get it today.

Unai Emery is possibly the best coach in the Premier League but has found past encounters with Oliver Glasner very uncomfortable.

Since Glasner’s arrival in English football with Crystal Palace in February 2024, he has faced Emery’s Villa seven times and never lost.

With five victories and two draws, it is an impressive record albeit with a different set of players.

Aston Villa and Forest are two teams in transition, and meet for the first time since that two-legged Europa League semi-final last season.

Villa are building a upcoming chapter after a summer of significant change, while Forest are implementing a totally different style of play under Oliver Glasner.

Industry observers note that there have been signs of progress at both of the former European Cup winners. Villa secured an impressive victory over Club Brugge in the Champions League on Tuesday. Forest are improving under Glasner, with their best performance the 2-2 draw at Liverpool.

Returning to Villa Park will have some bitter memories for a number of the Forest players, after that 4-0 defeat in the second leg of the Europa League.

Ollie Watkins and Emi Martinez departed for pastures fresh in the transfer window.

Good afternoon and welcome to our live coverage of this afternoon’s Premier League three o’clock kick-offs, and home bankers would appear to be the theme of the day.

In a recent development, liverpool will be strongly fancied to put Fulham to the sword at Anfield, with confidence low at the London club and new manager Alvaro Arbeloa (once a player at Anfield) already under pressure amid reports of dressing room unrest. Andoni Iraola secured his first Premier League victory as Liverpool manager at Ipswich last time out, and backed up that result with a come-from-behind win against Atletico Madrid in the Champions League.

Chelsea host Hull City, who are unbeaten after three games and have yet to concede a goal. It is a remarkable start to the season for Sergej Jakirović‘s side, who continue to defy expectations as well as the underlying data. For all their spirit and defensive organisation, keeping out Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Joao Pedro at Stamford Bridge promises to be a tall order, though.

Aston Villa’s rocky start to the campaign took a turn for the better with a 3-2 Champions League victory at Club Brugge, and as the weeks go by Unai Emery’s team should grow stronger as their raft of young signings bed in. Nottingham Forest could be obdurate opponents, although Villa swept them aside in the second leg of last season’s Europa League semi-final. Oliver Glasner’s Crystal Palace were a bogey team for Villa though, with the Austrian coach undefeated against Emery having notched up some resounding victories.

Glasner’s former club Palace could do with a home win against Ipswich Town, while there is cigarette paper between Bournemouth and Brentford, two of the league’s smartest operators who play at the Vitality Stadium this afternoon. Bournemouth qualified for Europe at Brentford’s expense last season, but Marco Rose is looking for his first league win despite some encouraging performances.

(ANSA) - ROMA, 20 NOV - "Noi dobbiamo vivere alla giornata e vedremo dove si può arrivare, i ragionamenti sulla classifica si potranno fare nelle ultime 7 o 8 giornate. L'importante è non sbagliare a livello di atteggiamento, se gli altri saranno più bravi di noi gli stringeremo la mano. Non dobbiamo dimenticare cosa ci ha portato fino qui e da dove siamo partiti". Sono queste le parole di Gennaro Gattuso, tecnico della Lazio, nella conferenza stampa che anticipa la sfida al Lecce.

Il tecnico laziale, poi, parlando del match contro la squadra di Di Francesco sottolinea come questa sia "solida e allenata bene, insidiosa sui calci piazzati; bisognerà prenderla con le pinze. Serviranno mentalità, voglia di stare in campo e di giocare a ritmi elevati. Sarà difficile". Mentre a chi chiede del proprio futuro ammette che "a me piace fare il gitano, la mia crescita viene anche dai giri che ho fatto. Qui mi trovo a mio agio e spero di rimanerci a lungo. Difficilmente puoi trovare posti dove si può lavorare come stiamo lavorando io e il mio staff", conclude. (ANSA).

In a recent development, un incredibile retroscena di Lele Adani che riguarda anche Lautaro Martinez, attaccante e capitano dell’Inter. Queste le parole dell’ex difensore al podcast Passa dal BSMT di Gianluca Gazzoli.

Recent findings suggest that "La partita più incredibile mai commentata è stata Argentina-Inghilterra, semifinale di questo Mondiale. Un dono di Dio totale. Arrivo a descrivertela facendoti capire perché: non è chi vince o chi perde, ma la dinamica che ha portato ad abbracciare il confine. Per chi crede ciò che accade è accaduto il significato più grande di una partita unica nella rivalità tra nazionali vissuta 40 anni prima con Maradona in un momento in forte proprio a livello anche sociopolitico culturale e militare e l'aspetto calcistico che Maradona con la sua aura la sua grandezza.

Gonfiò e motivò fino ad arrivare a uno scontro che andava oltre il campo da calcio che però è diventato magico grazie a ciò che è successo in campo. Ecco, la cosa si è replicata quarant'anni dopo e la partita poteva andare in un modo, ma è grazie a quel modo che m'ha portato non a esagerare, a replicare. Io non vado sopra il campo, non ci vado mai. E quando Messi diventa Maradona. E permette all'Argentina di vincere quella partita in rimonta, dominando da solo il secondo tempo dopo che l'Inghilterra era andata in avanti fino a fare quella giocata che è una delle giocate più belle, più incredibili, più folli della storia del calcio, cioè è l'assist per Lautaro Martinez che lui fa di destro al novantaduesimo a 39 anni, mettendo fuori 7 calciatori e un portiere che poteva usare le mani, ha messo la biglia nella fronte di Lautaro.

Industry observers note that L'Argentina ha ribaltato e 40 anni in una notte cioè ora come allora quello a me fa andare oltre e dove sono andato oltre non in quello che ho detto ma nell'ultima parola quando dico Lautaro Martinez che mi rimane un po' ecco quella cosa è l'imperfezione che l'ha resa perfetta. È tutto ciò che tanti che non sentono non capiscono perché Gianlu e concludo perché per tanti è un cross per tanti la giocata di Lionel è un cross come altri dici invece capisci… È anche il tuo lavoro romanticizzarla questa cosa qui no in qualche modo più romantico di quello. Ovviamente questa roba fatta da Messi ha un valore ancora più alto".

Breaking: Lazio, forza del gruppo, Dele-Bashiru: "Quest'anno siamo molto più uniti"

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (547 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Laziopress

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Il centrocampista parla del buon avvio di stagione e del clima nel gruppo.
  • Fisayo Dele-Bashiru è stato intervistato ai microfoni di Lazio Style Channel al rientro dagli impegni con la Nazionale, in vista della sfida di sabato tra Lazio e Lecce.
  • CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il centrocampista parla del buon avvio di stagione e del clima nel gruppo.

Fisayo Dele-Bashiru è stato intervistato ai microfoni di Lazio Style Channel al rientro dagli impegni con la Nazionale, in vista della sfida di sabato tra Lazio e Lecce. Nel confronto racconta l'energia portata da Gattuso, la concorrenza interna e la voglia di dare il massimo per la squadra.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

According to recent reports, sto bene. Sono felice di essere tornato a Roma. Naturalmente, essere convocato in Nazionale è sempre un momento speciale, soprattutto in occasione delle qualificazioni alla Coppa d'Africa. Le partite sono andate abbastanza bene. La prima è stata positiva, la seconda poteva andare meglio, ma sono felice di essere tornato a Roma. Nel fine settimana ci aspetta una partita importante e non vediamo l'ora di giocarla.

Penso che quest'anno abbiamo iniziato molto bene con Gattuso. Ha portato nuova energia nello spogliatoio e credo che questo si veda nei rapporti tra i compagni, nel nostro rapporto con l'allenatore e anche in quello con i tifosi. Se riusciremo a continuare su questa strada, sarà perfetto.

Tanto, in questo momento c'è molta concorrenza. Quando ho l'opportunità di entrare in campo per aiutare la squadra, cerco sempre di dare il massimo. Se dovessi giocare nel fine settimana, darò come sempre tutto me stesso. Credo che questo sia importante perché, per arrivare lontano in campionato, non bisogna poter contare soltanto sugli undici titolari: anche i giocatori in panchina devono dare il proprio contributo. È fondamentale.

Credo che la concorrenza sia sicuramente positiva e faccia bene. Tutte le migliori squadre del mondo hanno molta competizione interna e penso che questo permetta alla squadra di esprimere al meglio. In questo momento l'atmosfera è molto buona. Credo che nello spogliatoio ci siano molte più battute e momenti di leggerezza rispetto alla scorsa stagione, quando la situazione era differente. Quest'anno siamo molto più uniti e questo contribuisce sicuramente a creare un bel clima all'interno del gruppo.

Da quando sono alla Lazio ho avuto diversi allenatori. Credo che quest'anno un aspetto importante sia il grande coinvolgimento di Gattuso nel lavoro con il gruppo e con ogni singolo giocatore. Ha un ottimo rapporto con tutti i componenti della squadra e penso che questo sia fondamentale. Inoltre, sa perfettamente cosa significhi essere in campo ai massimi livelli, avendo avuto una grande carriera da calciatore. È un allenatore di altissimo livello, tutti i ragazzi gli vogliono bene e dobbiamo continuare a ottenere risultati per lui.

A livello personale sono una persona piuttosto tranquilla. Non lascio che quello che succede all'esterno influenzi troppo il mio modo di essere. Penso di comportarmi in campo proprio come nella vita di tutti i giorni: sono abbastanza rilassato e calmo, anche se so essere aggressivo quando serve. Direi che queste sono le caratteristiche che mi descrivono meglio.

Industry observers note that A livello personale, il mio obiettivo è giocare il maggior numero possibile di partite e aiutare la squadra il più possibile, magari con gol e assist. Se riuscirò a fare tutto questo, penso che sarà una stagione davvero molto positiva, non soltanto per me, ma anche per tutti i ragazzi. Adesso dobbiamo semplicemente continuare a lavorare partita dopo partita. Speriamo di riuscire a proseguire su questa buona strada.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il centrocampista classe 2011 è stato impiegato da Rughetti in tutte le partite della stagione.

It has been revealed that andrea Morresi è il regista del centrocampo della Lazio di Rughetti. Secondo quanto riportato da Gazzetta Regionale, Il classe 2011, arrivato dal Perugia nell’estate del 2025, gioca davanti alla difesa ed è stato impiegato dal tecnico in tutte le partite di questa stagione. Nel derby con la Roma, un suo filtrante ha messo Coppola nelle condizioni di segnare il gol del momentaneo 2-1.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Industry observers note that morresi era approdato nella capitale nella passata stagione, entrando nell’Under 15. Si è preso presto le chiavi della mediana biancoceleste, interpretando il ruolo di playmaker anche nel campionato attuale. La sua presenza è un punto fermo nelle scelte di Rughetti.

Sources indicate that prima del passaggio al Perugia, Morresi è cresciuto nel settore giovanile della Treiese, dai Piccoli Amici ai Pulcini. L’arrivo alla Lazio nell’estate del 2025 ha aperto una nuova tappa del suo percorso: con la maglia biancoceleste ha trovato spazio stabilmente davanti alla difesa.

Sources indicate that in quella posizione gestisce il pallone, distribuisce il gioco e cerca gli spazi per i compagni. Alla visione di gioco unisce tecnica e corsa nelle due fasi. Il suo destro si è già fatto notare anche sui calci di punizione, una soluzione con cui può rendersi decisivo.

Il suo contributo non si esaurisce però nella regia arretrata. Quando si apre la possibilità, Morresi avanza verso la trequarti avversaria. È dunque coinvolto sia nella costruzione delle azioni sia nel lavoro che precede le iniziative offensive della squadra.

Industry observers note that fino alla domenica del derby, la Lazio condivideva con la Roma l’imbattibilità in campionato. I biancocelesti si presentavano alla sfida con una struttura difensiva che li rendeva la seconda miglior difesa del raggruppamento. Anche il lavoro di Morresi davanti alla retroguardia contribuisce all’equilibrio della squadra.

Contro i giallorossi, il numero 4 ha giocato in una zona di campo particolarmente affollata. Dall’altra parte c’era il miglior attacco del girone, capace di mettere alla prova la mediana biancoceleste. La Roma ha prevalso per 3-1 dopo aver dominato gran parte degli 80 minuti, ma nella ripresa la Lazio ha trovato la forza di reagire.

L’episodio che ha riaperto momentaneamente la partita è nato dai piedi di Morresi. Un suo passaggio filtrante ha raggiunto Coppola in posizione favorevole; il compagno ha poi mandato il pallone in rete per il 2-1. La speranza biancoceleste si è spenta con il terzo gol romanista, firmato da Abate.

Un gesto di solidarietà che può fare la differenza. Sabato 21 novembre, dalle 9 alle 13, il Center Union di Aversa, in Viale Kennedy 35, ospiterà “Dona, fai la differenza”, iniziativa promossa da Union Gas e Luce in collaborazione con la Casa del Donatore di Aversa per sensibilizzare sull’importanza della donazione del sangue.

Sources indicate that all’evento parteciperà anche Patrizio Oliva, campione olimpico di pugilato e testimonial di Union, che incontrerà i partecipanti e sosterrà la campagna di sensibilizzazione. «Non serve essere campioni per fare un gesto da campioni», è il messaggio lanciato dall’ex pugile. L’iniziativa si inserisce nell’impegno di Union a favore del territorio e della responsabilità sociale, con l’obiettivo di coinvolgere cittadini, associazioni e realtà locali nella promozione della cultura della donazione. «L’energia più bella è quella che condividiamo», il messaggio che accompagna l’evento.

Le ultime dai campi e le probabili formazioni di Parma-Roma:.

Sources indicate that il ritorno del campionato porta con sé una seria emergenza in difesa per il Parma, che dovrà rinunciare a Ndiaye (squalificato), oltre a Drobnic e Diego Carlos, le cui condizioni sono ancora in bilico. Gilardino punterà comunque sulla difesa a tre, che vedrà l’inserimento di Carboni come braccetto sinistro, mentre Troilo e Delprato completeranno il reparto. Passando alle corsie laterali, a sinistra non si tocca Valeri, mentre sulla destra è aperto il ballottaggio tra Britschgi e Cremaschi, con il primo in vantaggio. A centrocampo si registra un recupero importante: quello di Bernabé, anche se potrebbe essere schierato solo a gara in corso. Sulla mediana Keita è sicuro del posto, mentre Sierro si giocherà una maglia con Nicolussi, che punta a riprendersi la titolarità. A completare la linea ci penserà Fabbian, in vantaggio su Ordonez. Infine non mancano dubbi anche in attacco, dove si ripartirà certamente da Lontani, ma chi sarà ad affiancarlo? Senza Romero (infortunato), fino a questo momento la scelta è ricaduta su Touré, ma Gilardino potrebbe optare per la fisicità di Elphege. (da Parma, Edoardo Mammoli).

It has been revealed that gasperini sembra orientato a confermare il consueto 3-4-2-1, con qualche possibile novità rispetto all’ultima uscita contro il Sassuolo. Tra i pali tornerà Svilar, mentre in difesa dovrebbero trovare spazio Mancini, Ndicka ed Hermoso. Balerdi rappresenta un’alternativa, ma potrebbe essere condizionato dagli impegni con la nazionale argentina. Sulla corsia destra Molina parte favorito su Lulli, mentre a sinistra dovrebbe essere confermato Wesley. In mezzo al campo spazio alla coppia formata da Cristante e Koné. Sulla trequarti Dybala è in vantaggio su Mora per affiancare Soulé. La Joya punta quindi a tornare titolare dal primo minuto. In avanti Malen sarà ancora il principale riferimento offensivo. (da Roma, Marco Campanella).

Le ultime dai campi e le probabili formazioni di Napoli-Torino:.

In a recent development, il Napoli si prepara alla sfida contro il Torino con un possibile ritorno al 4-3-3. Massimiliano Allegri potrebbe affidarsi a Kevin De Bruyne in cabina di regia, con Anguissa e McTominay ai suoi lati. In attacco spazio al tridente composto da Politano, Hojlund e Lang. Tra i pali si è fermato Meret, quindi spazio a Milinkovic-Savic, con la linea difensiva a quattro che dovrebbe essere composta da Beukema, Rrahmani, Rafa Marin e Spinazzola. A centrocampo De Bruyne potrebbe tornare nel ruolo di playmaker, affiancato da Anguissa e McTominay. Nel reparto offensivo Politano (ma occhio a Vergara) e Lang agiranno sulle corsie esterne, con Hojlund riferimento centrale. (da Napoli, Arturo Minervini).

Industry observers note that il Torino partirà per Napoli con il dubbio Vlasic: il croato è tornato dalla Nazionale con un affaticamento muscolare, potrebbe stringere ma in caso di forfait si scalda Casadei. In attacco non si sono dubbi e giocheranno il grande ex Simeone insieme ad Adams, sulle corsie laterali sono favoriti Belghali e Cacciamani con Mandragora che tornerà titolare e Bragança al suo fianco. Anche in difesa il tecnico Abate confermerà il terzetto che aveva trovato continuità prima della sosta, con Ismajli tra Coco e Comuzzo davanti al portiere Perri. (da Torino, Emanuele Pastorella).

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Tottenham Hotspur have never before in the club’s history begun a league season without scoring a single goal in the first four games, although having done so after spending £329m on new players really does take some doing.

“Please score a goal!” was the homemade sign from two Spurs fans upon which the television cameras lingered at the end of the game, although the jaunty felt-tip design and glued-on team crest were rather upbeat compared to the gloom of the stadium. Spurs have tried to outrun their past but it just keeps catching up with them.

A team reimagined, a manager freshly debuted and yet they are back in the same grip of anxiety that accompanied them on two consecutive 17th-place finishes in the last two seasons. By the end of this they might have been glad to escape with a single point against Everton, the one team in the Premier League who closed the window with a net transfer profit.

Recent findings suggest that for Roberto De Zerbi, there was another passionate defence of his team afterwards. “The people, the fans already understand if I make excuses or not,” he said. “I came last season when the s--- was like this”, he gestured to a level somewhere around the midpoint of his forehead. “I have always been… not positive but realistic. I am sorry for the result that it’s not immediately the improvement. We played as a team. We didn’t score. We didn’t win [but] we played as a team.”.

Indeed he co-opted the Italian term “sbloccare” to describe his team’s problem. They simply need to unlock – or unblock – the team and the goals would flow. He joked that in Italy he would be lauded for two consecutive clean sheets in this game and the previous one against Nottingham Forest. “What did you write?” he demanded of one of the Italian newspaper correspondents. “You have the passport.”.

It has been revealed that spurs have one last game at home this month, on Saturday against Aston Villa, to end the streak in September. They were into the second half before the first attempt on target that obliged Jordan Pickford to make a save – Mateus Fernandes’s shot slapping limply against the Everton goalkeeper’s gloves to ironic cheers from the home fans.

Industry observers note that at the end De Zerbi could not contain his frustration, unable to wait until he reached the privacy of the dressing room to tell Mathys Tel where he had gone wrong. He did so with the Spurs substitute still wiping the sweat from his brow on the pitch. The player did not look at all impressed. De Zerbi said later that he was simply reminding his player of what it took to play as a central striker.

It has been revealed that “There is a term in Italian, ‘sbloccare’ that literally translates as ‘unblock’… I know we can score goals and win games. We have to respect the history of the players – if you forget [Dominic] Solanke and [Omar] Marmoush the others haven’t scored many in their careers. I think we can find the goals with the quality of the players.”.

Spurs play Liverpool at Anfield in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday before Villa a week today. The Spurs record at home is dismal. In the last 35 games they have won just five, drawn 10 and lost a remarkable 20. This new stadium has become a problem for the team in it – or maybe it is the other way around.

In a recent development, A good result for Everton, who were under pressure for most of the first half but had much the better of it after the break. David Moyes’s team finished the game with more shots on target than the home team. Moyes managed the game well and trusted his team to withstand the Spurs possession in the first half until they reached a point where Everton could start to push back.

Hard to pick out any major chances – it was that kind of game – but Brennan Johnson should have won it for the away team in the second half. The ball was cut back to him by Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall and the former Spurs man skied his shot.

According to recent reports, some surprised faces then when Moyes said later that he had expected a lot more from his team. He acknowledged the resilience in defence and the importance of the clean sheet. “We played well enough,” he said, “but when we had the ball we turned it over more often than we should have done.”.

Industry observers note that the game had started with Vitaliy Mykolenko being tortured by the pace of Sávio and ended with the Ukrainian left-back being given the man of the match award. Like many of his team-mates, he had hung in there. There was another fine performance from Jarrad Branthwaite at centre-half and Moyes said that he hoped it might earn him a place in the England squad. “He is still finding his way back from injury,” Moyes said, “it would be great if he could get a call-up.”.

In the directors’ box were the usual pained expressions of Vinai Venkatesham, the Spurs chief executive, and chairman Peter Charrington. They sat alongside Vivienne Lewis, daughter of the patriarch Joe. There is a certain fatigue about the home crowd when faced with afternoons like this which suggests they have seen so much that the bar is quite high – or low – to provoke a really splenetic response. Perhaps it is just too early in the season although the final whistle was met with boos.

The first shot on target of the entire game for either side was a free-kick struck by James Garner in added time at the end of the first half. Spurs had started at a ferocious pace although they could not sustain it.

De Zerbi complained about the pre-season injuries on tour in Australia and also the lack of time he had to integrate Sávio and Marmoush. He mentioned that his team were not in the right “physical condition”.

In a recent development, “We played very well in the first 30 minutes and maybe the energy and the fact we didn’t score – we lost confidence.” By the end, he had sent on James Maddison, Tel, Lucas Bergvall and Mohammed Kudus to little avail. Everton looked more likely to win it.

According to recent reports, speaking to Sky Sports, the Everton defender remarked: “You look at the game from the start, they put us under pressure and we had to dig deep to stay in the game. Then we grew into the game towards the end of the first half and showed that mentality again in the second half.

It has been revealed that “We had chances to win the game as well. The backs to the wall mentality will help us go a long way. If we can keep clean sheets, you can go a long way in the league. But it’s not just us the defenders. It’s the whole team working hard. It’s a team effort.”.

Boos ring around the ground as Spurs and Everton both have to settle for a point. Tottenham’s winless start to the season continues, while Everton’s unbeaten run remains intact. Spurs haven’t managed a goal in six hours of Premier League football across the 2026-27 campaign. Tottenham sit 17th with two points. Everton are up to seventh and will certainly take the draw.

Following Spurs’ reshuffle, it looks like Savio will stay out wide on the right, with Tel on the left. Kudus will sit as the central playmaker behind Marmoush, who is now the lone frontman.

The start of Spurs’ second-half performance is alarmingly similar to their display against Newcastle two weeks ago. Brennan Johnson spent two years at Tottenham and scored the winning goal in the 1-0 Europa League final victory over Manchester United in May 2025, ending the club’s 17-year trophy drought.

After a short, disappointing spell at Crystal Palace, Johnson joined Everton last month, with Dwight McNeil moving in the opposite direction.

Midfielder took exception to negativity surrounding club after moves for players on deadline day failed to materialise.

According to recent reports, “We signed Jack [Grealish], which was nice, and I’d been speaking to him,” claims Dewsbury-Hall, sitting in a café at the club’s Finch Farm training base. “But I had seen all the stuff [online], all the meltdowns about this and that and, in all honestly, it annoyed me a bit.

Recent findings suggest that “I get where people are coming from. Everyone wants to sign everyone and have the perfect squad, but there are still 19 lads in this building who are going to hopefully take this club to good things this year. That was getting disregarded. I was seeing people saying: ‘We’ll be lucky to stay up this year.’.

Industry observers note that “What message is that sending to the lads who are already here? I’m not blaming anyone. We get it. It didn’t work. But let’s all be positive – right, it’s done, bang, let’s go. That’s what we’ve been trying to say in the dressing room.”.

Earlier this week, Mykhailo Mudryk picked up an ankle injury in training which has ruled the Chelsea loanee out of action for as long as two months.

The winger only made his debut for Tottenham as a late substitute against Nottingham Forest last week, but his attempt to rebuild his career following his anti-doping ban has been dealt a major blow.

Folarin Balogun’s proposed £39m move from Monaco collapsed on transfer deadline day, Richarlison’s return to the club didn’t materialise and Beto was sold to Fiorentina, leaving Thierno Barry as Everton’s only recognised striker.

Nottingham Forest’s pursuit of academy product Harrison Armstrong ruffled the fans’ feathers, while Iliman Ndiaye was sold to Manchester City for £60m.

Dwight McNeil, Tim Iroegbunam, Nathan Patterson, Adam Aznou and Idrissa Gueye were also allowed to leave.

Merlin Rohl and Tyrique George made their loans permanent, while Brennan Johnson, Hayden Hackney and Christian Norgaard were also added to the squad.

Summer signing Ainsley Maitland-Niles and Vitaliy Mykolenko are David Moyes’ only options at full-back.

Overall, there were a number of solid additions, just not enough of them to cover all the departures.

Hello and welcome to our live coverage of this Premier League meeting between Tottenham and Everton in the capital.

It has been revealed that are Tottenham in must-win territory already? It may seem reactionary and premature, but after spending £380m in the summer to revamp an underperforming squad, Tottenham sit inside the relegation zone, with just one point and zero goals scored in three games.

Roberto De Zerbi’s men opened the 2026-27 top-flight season with worrying back-to-back defeats to Brentford and Newcastle United, before ending their losing streak last weekend thanks to a goalless draw against Nottingham Forest.

According to recent reports, this game gives Tottenham another opportunity to reverse their dreadful home form. Last season, Spurs managed just three league wins at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and lost 10. Il mercato di gennaio resta incerto: Lotito cerca il via libera e Fabiani valuta anche il centrocampista apprezzato da Gattuso.

Marco Brescianini e Denis Man sono due profili sondati da Fabiani per la Lazio, mentre resta da chiarire se il club potrà operare nel mercato di gennaio. Secondo quanto riportato da Lottomatica, Lotito sta lavorando a un piano economico-finanziario che permetta al direttore sportivo di cercare rinforzi per Gattuso, secondo quanto riferisce Lottomatica.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

According to recent reports, fino a qualche settimana fa, il blocco del mercato sembrava quasi certo. Lotito punta però a ottenere il via libera della Commissione indipendente, che ha preso il posto della Covisoc.

Tra le operazioni su cui lavora ci sono l’anticipo dei crediti futuri legati alle sponsorizzazioni e una proroga per dilazionare il pagamento delle vecchie imposte relative agli anni del Covid. Dall’esito di questo lavoro dipende la possibilità per Fabiani di intervenire a gennaio.

Nel frattempo, Fabiani sta valutando diversi calciatori. Uno dei nomi indicati è Marco Brescianini, che la fonte presenta come giocatore di proprietà della Fiorentina. Gattuso lo apprezza soprattutto per la capacità di inserirsi in area di rigore.

Industry observers note that L’operazione non viene considerata semplice. La Lazio può comunque contare su un elemento nei rapporti per un’eventuale trattativa: Brescianini ha lo stesso agente di Pinamonti.

England's newly introduced plan of attack: Thomas Tuchel has switched style since World Cup but clunky win over Croatia demonstrated growing pains - Spain will put it to severe test, writes JACK GAUGHAN
